renderer: render_fig_k_curve.py (hand-written matplotlib on the aii-data-fig-gen house style; the catalogue 'line' type has no asymmetric CI band, reference lines or k95 markers)

provenance.metric: pooled AUROC of the peer-consensus score c (fraction of k randomly drawn other model families whose formalization is NOT prover-equivalent to the candidate) for flagging incorrect candidates (y_AB); mean over 50 reproducible random k-family draws per row. NOT the stratified AUROC (strat_auroc_mean is a different, lower quantity).
provenance.population: development set E rows with all 7 other families available: n = 2014 candidate formalizations (1309 incorrect, 705 correct) from 186 sentences
provenance.long_tercile: T3 = longest-sentence tercile by word count (words_t)
provenance.ci: 95% sentence-cluster bootstrap CI (B = 2000) of the draw-mean AUROC; available for the overall series only (the artifact stores no CI for tercile curves)
provenance.k95_rule: k95 = smallest k with mean AUROC(k) >= 0.95 * AUROC(k = 7)

xlabel: Number of peer model families k
